name: City Council Special Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Special Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 4, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
 through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
 open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
 may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
 4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
 see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of November 13, 2024 City Council Regular Session Meeting and November 18,
2024 Closed Session Meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  2024 City of Westlake Village Business of the Quarter Presentation – 4th
  Quarter – Heart Boutique

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – 2025 LEGISLATIVE PLATFORM
  UPDATE – City Council to adopt the 2025 Legislative Platform.

2.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – COMMUNITY TROLLEY
  PROGRAM REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS - City Council to approve the
  Community Trolley request for proposals and authorize staff to issue.

3.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – UPDATE ON ASSESSMENT
  DISTRICT REVENUE PROGRAM BALLOTING TIMELINE - City Council to
  receive the information regarding a revised timeline for the Proposition 218
  balloting process for the Landscape Assessment Districts 1 and 15 and Lighting
  Assessment District 1 and provide comments and guidance to staff.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 95-005, MODIFICATION NO. 3;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2381-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2381-24, determining
  Modification No. 3 of Conditional Use Permit No. 95-005 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing the continuation of a pet grooming facility, located at 31143 Via
  Colinas, Suite. 501.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2381-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION 3 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 95-005, TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF A PET
  GROOMING FACILITY (IT’S PAWFECT) LOCATED AT 31143 VIA COLINAS, STE. 501

2.  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 19-006, MODIFICATION NO. 1;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2382-24 - Adopt Resolution No. 2382-24, determining
  Modification No. 1 of Conditional Use Permit No. 19-006 is exempt from CEQA
  and authorizing the continuation of a private indoor sports facility, located at 31425
  Agoura Road.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2382-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPROVING MODIFICATION 1 OF CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT NO. 19-006, TO AUTHORIZE THE CONTINUED OPERATION OF A PRIVATE
  INDOOR SPORTS FACILITY (PROACTIVE SPORTS) LOCATED AT 31425 AGOURA
  ROAD

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective November 15, 2024 in the
  amount of $399,088.63 and December 1, 2025 in the amount of $603,993,39.
   GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. ARTERIAL SYSTEM FINANCING PROGRAM ANNUAL REVIEW – City
  Council to receive the report. Report is provided for information only and no
  action is necessary.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  SOLAR AND STORAGE SITE LEASE AGREEMENT WITH COAST ENERGY
  FOR THE CIVIC CENTER SOLAR ROOF AND BACKUP BATTERY PROJECT
  - Authorize the Mayor to execute the Solar and Storage Site Lease Agreement with
  Coast Energy for the Westlake Village Civic Center as part of the Clean Power
  Alliance’s Power Ready Program.

NEW BUSINESS:

1.  ADOPTION OF PLANS AND SPECIFICATIONS, CEQA EXEMPTION
  DETERMINATION AND AUTHORIZATION TO ADVERTISE BIDS FOR
  COMMUNITY PARK SIGNAGE PROJECT AND TRASH ENCLOSURE
  PROJECT - Determine that the Community Park Signage Project and the Trash
  Enclosure Project are exempt from CEQA, adopt the plans and specifications for
  the Community Park Signage Project and the Trash Enclosure Project and
  authorize staff to advertise bids for the Community Park Signage and Trash
  Enclosure Projects.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Tuesday, November 26, 2024 at 5:30 p.m. on the City’s website and
in the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  November 26, 2024
